subject: Receipt printer offline - POS terminal T1 unable to communicate with printer
description: The receipt printer connected to POS terminal T1 (asset POS-0114-T1) at ServeWell Lokhandwala has been non-functional since approximately 09:15 IST this morning. When customers complete transactions, the system displays error message: 'Printer Offline - Unable to establish connection on LPT1'. The printer unit (Epson TM-M30) shows no error lights and appears powered on, but no test prints are being generated. We have already attempted the following troubleshooting steps: (1) Power cycled the printer twice with 30-second intervals; (2) Checked all USB and power cables are securely connected; (3) Restarted the POS terminal; (4) Verified printer driver status in device manager showing 'Device Error'. The printer was functioning normally until yesterday evening. Business impact: moderate - we are currently manually writing receipts for customers, but this is slowing down service during peak lunch hours (11:30-13:30). Running FoodTech POS v4.2.2. Request urgent investigation and either remote driver reinstallation or technician dispatch if hardware replacement is required.

ticket_history.note: Ticket received and acknowledged. Confirmed asset details and system version. Advised submitter to check printer USB cable connection and attempt uninstall/reinstall of printer driver from device manager before escalation.
Store manager confirmed driver reinstallation attempt unsuccessful - error persists. Escalating to L2 hardware support team for potential driver corruption or port failure diagnosis.
